mapper.select: SELECT USER_IDX AS userIdx, USER_ID AS userId, USER_NICKNAME AS userNickname, USER_AGE AS userAge, IS_REGISTERED_BUSINESS AS isRegisteredBusiness FROM USERS WHERE USER_IDX = #{userIdx}

SELECT P.POST_IDX AS postIdx, P.TITLE AS title, P.CONTENTS AS contents, P.VIEWS AS views, COUNT(DISTINCT C.COMMENT_IDX) AS commentCount, P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, CASE WHEN P.ATTACHMENT IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS hasAttachment FROM COMMUNITY_POST P LEFT JOIN POST_COMMENT C ON P.POST_IDX = C.POST_IDX WHERE P.USER_IDX = #{userIdx} GROUP BY P.POST_IDX, P.TITLE, P.CONTENTS, P.VIEWS, P.CREATED_AT, P.ATTACHMENT ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT C.COMMENT_IDX AS commentIdx, C.POST_IDX AS postIdx, P.TITLE AS postTitle, C.CONTENTS AS contents, C.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM POST_COMMENT C JOIN COMMUNITY_POST P ON C.POST_IDX = P.POST_IDX WHERE C.USER_IDX = #{userIdx} ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
